name: SOTA Mainline AR-GPTQ + XSA-all + BigramHash 3072x112 (SDPA)
blurb: Runnable derivative scaffold of the March 25, 2026 public SOTA stack. Keeps AR self-generated Full Hessian GPTQ calibration, XSA on all 11 layers, BigramHash(3072,112), selective +-1 pruning, Parallel Muon, and lzma preset=9, but uses the baseline-style PyTorch SDPA + GQA attention path instead of a hard flash_attn_interface dependency. Metrics pending verification.
author: fahmitech
